description: This file defines the class 'TemplateRadioEnum', a specialized template for rendering radio button enums in a CRM module, including methods for generating HTML for edit and search views, handling field definitions, and rendering display values.

classes.name: TemplateRadioEnum
classes.description: A class extending 'TemplateEnum' to provide radio button enum field rendering and handling functionality.

methods.name: get_html_edit
methods.description: Returns the HTML snippet for editing the radio enum field.

methods.name: get_field_def
methods.description: Provides the database field definition, including setting 'dbType' and 'separator'.

methods.name: get_xtpl_edit
methods.description: Prepares template variables for editing, including radio button options.

methods.name: generateRadioButtons
methods.description: Generates HTML radio button inputs based on the app list strings.

methods.name: get_xtpl_search
methods.description: Prepares template variables for search view.

methods.name: get_xtpl_detail
methods.description: Returns display value for detail view based on the bean's current value.

methods.name: get_db_default
methods.description: Returns an empty string as default database value.
